name: DietrichGebert/ponytail — ~103K Stars; Day 10; Laziness Ladder Cuts Code 54–94%
hook: ~103,000 stars. A Claude Code skill enforcing a 7-rung laziness ladder before writing a single line of custom code: stdlib first, native platform features second, existing dependencies third, one-liners before functions, and so on. name: thedotmack/claude-mem — ~90.8K Stars; Day 10; Persistent Context Across Sessions
hook: ~90,800 stars. Captures everything Claude does across sessions, compresses with AI, and auto-injects relevant context via lifecycle hooks — no manual context management. Works with Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
